column1: # Rift Apart materials' looks set in the game by the main session (PLAN 9.2), read by scripts/riftapart-pair.py write: the
# strength of the material's highlight (1 when a material is not listed: as the approved method lights it). The glossy ones
# (gloss over 0.6 in their _g red) blew out to white on bright surfaces under the game's lights (level 16's walkway, paint_003:
# white at 1, a soft sheen at 0.15); the others are set alike and checked on the every-level draw.
# metal (15 November 2026; the player: 'Other metal in the game in the world or enemy/npc models needs to be done similarly with
# varied levels of metalness roughness and shine'): how much of a metal the material is, 0 to 1 (1 bare and polished; a
# painted metal's paint is none, its chips some; rust almost none). Its roughness is its own map's gloss; its shine the specular.
# glass and leaves (15 November 2026): glass a little metal so it reflects its surroundings without the ray tracing (0.2 to 0.3); the derived leaf surfaces a soft sheen (specular 0.5).
